38. HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3 and QUIC

HTTP/1.1 supports persistent connections; HTTP/2 multiplexes streams over TCP; HTTP/3 uses
QUIC over UDP with independent stream delivery.
HTTP/1.1 connection reuse කරනවා. HTTP/2 එක TCP connection එකක streams multiplex කරනවා.
HTTP/3 එක UDP මත QUIC භාවිත කරනවා.

Q: Why does HTTP/3 use QUIC?
A: QUIC supports secure multiplexed streams and avoids TCP-level cross-stream head-of-line blocking.
